subject.title: Feature: configPatch in plugin manifest — automatic config setup on install

question: Should third-party plugin manifests be allowed to mutate persisted user configuration during installation, and if so which paths, consent flow, and rollback obligations are permitted?
rationale: The request would expand package metadata from declarative discovery into write authority over operator-owned configuration, and repository policy requires that security-sensitive convenience remain explicit and operator-controlled.

options.title: Typed setup intents
options.body: Permit only ownership-scoped setup operations with preview, confirmation, validation, provenance, conflict handling, and a skip path.

options.title: Arbitrary configPatch
options.body: Allow validated root-config deep merges from manifests and accept the broader overwrite, conflict, and cleanup surface.

options.title: Keep configuration explicit
options.body: Retain plugin-owned interactive setup or documented manual configuration without install-time manifest mutation.

recommendation.title: Typed setup intents
recommendation.body: Permit only ownership-scoped setup operations with preview, confirmation, validation, provenance, conflict handling, and a skip path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin-management implementation history and the prior issue review make steipete the strongest available routing candidate for this product and security decision.
